{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: cli/commands/deploy.py (developer tooling)
RECURRING PROBLEM: Hang on exit in the deploy command across multiple separate incidents

COMMON PATTERN ACROSS ALL INCIDENTS:
- Signal: Process finishes work but never returns
- Repro method: Deploy the sample project and wait
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/cli/test_deploy.py

---

INCIDENT 1 [2026-07-01]:
- Environment: Staging read replica only
- Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #1275, branch: fix/hang-on-exit-1
- Measurable result: Throughput rose 39% to 342 requests per second

INCIDENT 2 [2026-07-22]:
- Trigger condition: Input list came in empty
- Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #3897, branch: fix/hang-on-exit-2
- Measurable result: Backlog cleared 71 minutes after the deploy

INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-26]:
- Trigger condition: Sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: Error swallowed by a bare except handler
- Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #7462, branch: fix/hang-on-exit-3
- Measurable result: p99 latency fell from 4.3s to 477ms"}
